item.title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text.

item.tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

answer_sheet.Platform and dimensions: Instagram feed; either square or 4:5 portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Bring home some green” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Visual content and style: Lots of lush potted houseplants on a clean cream background.

must_haves: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.

turns.text: Could you make a post for a little houseplant shop, with lots of lush potted houseplants? I have a soft spot for little plant shops, so I’m probably overthinking how to explain this. It’s for an Instagram feed, and the headline should be exactly “Bring home some green”. I’d like a clean cream background behind all the plants. I’m a little worried my rambling makes this sound more complicated than it is. There should be no other text besides that headline.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a beautiful square Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush, healthy potted houseplants arranged in a rich, abundant, thoughtfully composed grouping across the lower two-thirds: monstera, ferns, pothos, rubber plants, calatheas and small leafy plants, varied heights in tasteful terracotta and neutral ceramic pots. Clean solid cream background behind all plants, soft natural lighting and subtle shadows, fresh green foliage, polished botanical product photography with charming independent plant shop warmth. Leave clear airy cream negative space at the top for a prominent, beautifully legible dark green headline. The headline must read exactly: “Bring home some green” (without quotation marks). This headline is the ONLY text anywhere in the image. No other words, labels, logos, watermarks, price tags or lettering. Keep the typography clean and elegant, with careful spacing and strong readability.
